; unremarkable - a short poem about whatever you circle on the page.
; Adds a button to the handwriting selection menu, runs reMarkable's own
; recognizer over the selection, and feeds the text to the local model.

AFFECT /qml/common/SceneSelectionHandler.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#selectionRoot
        LOCATE BEFORE cut
        INSERT {
            signal askHaiku
        }
    END TRAVERSE
    TRAVERSE ?#tools
        LOCATE BEFORE ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button#convertToText
        INSERT {
            ArkControls.ContextualMenu.Button {
                id: askHaikuButton
                focusPolicy: Qt.NoFocus
                type: tools.type
                iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/notebook_sparkles"
                onClicked: selectionRoot.askHaiku()
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    TRAVERSE ?#selectionHandler
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            onAskHaiku: {
                console.log("[unremarkable] askHaiku requested");
                root.convertSelection(function () {
                    hwcSelectionTool.askHaikuFrom(
                        controller.cloneSelectedItems(controller.currentLayer,
                                                      root.defaultScale));
                    root.endItemSelection();
                });
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/HwcSelection.qml
    IMPORT QtQuick.Controls 2.0
    IMPORT net.asivery.CommandExecutor 1.0

    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE BEFORE convert
        INSERT {
            property bool askingHaiku: false
            property string haikuSubject: ""
            property string haikuText: ""
            property string haikuStatus: "idle"
            property var haikuMeta: null

            CommandExecutor { id: haikuRunner }

            function askHaikuFrom(items) {
                askingHaiku = true;
                Recognizer.startSelectionToolJob(items,
                    Settings.handwritingConversionLanguage);
            }

            function haikuTopLevel() {
                var node = haikuPopup.parent ? haikuPopup.parent : root;
                node = root;
                while (node.parent) { node = node.parent; }
                return node;
            }

            function stripQuotes(text) {
                var marks = String.fromCharCode(34, 39, 8220, 8221, 8216, 8217);
                while (text.length > 0 && marks.indexOf(text.charAt(0)) >= 0) {
                    text = text.substring(1);
                }
                while (text.length > 0
                       && marks.indexOf(text.charAt(text.length - 1)) >= 0) {
                    text = text.substring(0, text.length - 1);
                }
                return text.trim();
            }

            function wordCount(text) {
                if (!text) return 0;
                var parts = text.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(" ").split(" ");
                var total = 0;
                for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
                    if (parts[i].length > 0) total++;
                }
                return total;
            }

            function haikuPoem(raw) {
                if (!raw) return "";
                var text = raw;
                var split = text.indexOf(String.fromCharCode(10, 10));
                if (split >= 0) text = text.substring(0, split);
                text = stripQuotes(text.trim());
                var lines = text.split(String.fromCharCode(10));
                if (lines.length > 6) lines = lines.slice(0, 6);
                return lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
            }

            function haikuRead(path, cb) {
                var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
                xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
                    if (xhr.readyState === XMLHttpRequest.DONE) cb(xhr.responseText);
                };
                xhr.open("GET", "file://" + path);
                xhr.send();
            }

            function haikuPoll() {
                haikuRead("/home/root/unremarkable/state/out.txt",
                          function(t) { root.haikuText = t; });
                haikuRead("/home/root/unremarkable/state/status",
                          function(s) {
                              root.haikuStatus = s;
                              if (s === "done") haikuTimer.stop();
                          });
                haikuRead("/home/root/unremarkable/state/meta.json",
                          function(m) {
                              try { root.haikuMeta = JSON.parse(m); }
                              catch (e) { root.haikuMeta = null; }
                          });
            }

            function askHaikuAbout(subject) {
                root.haikuSubject = subject;
                root.haikuText = "";
                root.haikuStatus = "running";
                haikuRunner.executeCommand("/home/root/unremarkable/ask-bg.sh",
                                           ["about", subject, "80"]);
                haikuPopup.parent = haikuTopLevel();
                haikuPopup.open();
                haikuTimer.start();
            }

            Timer {
                id: haikuTimer
                interval: 2000
                repeat: true
                onTriggered: root.haikuPoll()
            }

            Popup {
                id: haikuPopup
                modal: true
                focus: true
                width: 1000
                height: 980
                anchors.centerIn: parent
                padding: 0
                closePolicy: Popup.CloseOnEscape | Popup.CloseOnPressOutside

                background: Rectangle {
                    color: "#ffffff"
                    border.color: "#000000"
                    border.width: 3
                }

                contentItem: Item {
                    Column {
                        anchors.fill: parent
                        anchors.margins: 64
                        spacing: 0

                        Text {
                            text: "Unremarkable"
                            font.family: "EB Garamond"
                            font.pixelSize: 52
                            font.weight: Font.Normal
                            color: "#000000"
                        }
                        Text {
                            text: (root.haikuStatus === "running"
                                   ? "Generating a poem for \u201c"
                                   : "A poem for \u201c")
                                  + root.haikuSubject + "\u201d"
                            font.family: "EB Garamond"
                            font.italic: true
                            font.pixelSize: 30
                            color: "#000000"
                            width: 872
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                            topPadding: 6
                        }

                        Rectangle {
                            width: 872; height: 2
                            color: "#000000"
                            y: 28
                        }

                        Item { width: 1; height: 70 }

                        Text {
                            width: 872
                            text: root.haikuText === ""
                                  ? "\u00b7 \u00b7 \u00b7"
                                  : root.haikuPoem(root.haikuText)
                            font.family: "EB Garamond"
                            font.pixelSize: 46
                            color: "#000000"
                            lineHeight: 1.45
                            lineHeightMode: Text.ProportionalHeight
                            wrapMode: Text.WordWrap
                            horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
                            maximumLineCount: 8
                            elide: Text.ElideRight
                        }
                    }

                    Column {
                        anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
                        anchors.left: parent.left
                        anchors.right: parent.right
                        anchors.margins: 64
                        spacing: 18

                        Rectangle { width: 872; height: 1; color: "#000000" }

                        Text {
                            text: "SmolLM2-135M-Instruct \u00b7 fp32 \u00b7 armv7l @ 1.2GHz"
                            font.family: "Noto Sans Mono"
                            font.pixelSize: 19
                            color: "#000000"
                        }
                        Text {
                            text: root.haikuMeta
                                  ? "ttft " + (root.haikuMeta.ttft_ms / 1000).toFixed(1)
                                    + "s  \u00b7  " + root.haikuMeta.decode_tok_s.toFixed(2)
                                    + " tok/s  \u00b7  " + root.haikuMeta.generated_tokens
                                    + " tok  \u00b7  " + Math.round(root.haikuMeta.peak_rss_mib)
                                    + " MiB rss"
                                  : "generating \u00b7 " + root.wordCount(root.haikuText)
                                    + " words \u00b7 ~1 tok/s"
                            font.family: "Noto Sans Mono"
                            font.pixelSize: 19
                            color: "#000000"
                        }
                    }
                }

                onClosed: haikuTimer.stop()
            }

        }
    END TRAVERSE

    TRAVERSE ?#handwritingBar
        REBUILD onFinishedChanged
        LOCATE AFTER STREAM / { /
        INSERT {
if (askingHaiku) {
    if (!finished) {
        return;
    }
    var subject = recognitionJob.plainText.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).join(" ").trim();
    console.log("[unremarkable] recognized subject: [" + subject + "]");
    askingHaiku = false;
    if (subject !== "") {
        root.askHaikuAbout(subject);
    }
    return;
}
}
        END REBUILD
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
